result.summary: Adds test coverage for edge cases in transaction decoding and deserialization. Tests handle an invalid witness flag of 0x02, witness elements longer than remaining payload data, truncated fields, and truncated CompactSize prefixes. It also ensures DecodeHexTx rejects these payloads instead of falling back to decoding them as legacy non-witness transactions.
result.problem: Transaction deserialization test suites lack explicit coverage for several malformed and truncated wire encodings, leaving open the risk of regressions or unintended fallback decoding in utility decoders.
evidence: PR description: 'These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)'
result.card: Adds tests covering malformed and truncated transaction encodings, such as invalid witness flags, witness elements exceeding data bounds, and truncated CompactSize prefixes. It also verifies DecodeHexTx does not fall back to parsing malformed payloads as valid non-witness transactions. The author identified these test gaps when examining an alternative implementation (bitcoin-s). The PR is test-only (+42 lines) with low risk and no dependencies.
uncertainties: Diff was not provided, though the commit message and description clearly delineate the added test assertions.

risk.why: A mistake in test vectors could cause false CI failures without affecting production node behavior.
